characters.title: auth, the token locksmith
characters.personality: I am 149 lines across 3 files, with auth/tokens.ts at 58 lines and 0 TODOs. I issue 15-minute access tokens and 30-day refresh tokens, then verify them with timingSafeEqual, which is solid and slightly paranoid.
characters.catchphrase: 15-minute access tokens, 30-day refresh tokens, and no nonsense.
characters.greeting: I am auth: 149 total lines across 3 files, with auth/tokens.ts at 58 lines. I have 0 TODOs and 2 test files, which is cleaner than the usual damn token jungle.
gossip: issueToken() signs base64url claims with createHmac('sha256', SECRET).
verifyToken() rejects the wrong scope before returning claims.
SECRET falls back to 'dev-only-secret', which is fine for local noise.
The session lookup in refresh flow is called a read, because semantics never sleep.
